import os
import sys
import time

# ==========================================
# 🌟 iPhone 免黑視窗專用：自動下載環境套件

try:
    import yfinance as yf

except ImportError:

import requests
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

# ==========================================
# ⚙️ 核心設定區：您的 Discord Webhook 網址
# ==========================================
DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1509236757277708391/q01BcfdfN7Ya80lyOrM5v1m0JZQI7oT9xZHIo8eSx0SHPArpncB_NihO5MAfPVeepbXZ'

def send_discord(message):
    """發送 Discord 通知"""
    payload = {"content": message}
    try:
        response = requests.post(DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL, json=payload)
        return response.status_code in [200, 204]
    except:
        return False

def get_all_tw_tickers():
    """自動從證交所抓取所有最新的上市股票代號，並過濾掉權證與ETF"""
    print("📡 正在向台灣證券交易所獲取最新股票清單...")
    url = "https://isin.twse.com.tw/isin/C_public.jsp?strMode=2"
    
    try:
        tables = pd.read_html(url)
        df = tables[0]
        df.columns = df.iloc[0]
        df = df.iloc[1:]
        
        df = df[df['CFICode'] == 'ESVTFR']
        
        ticker_dict = {}
        for item in df['有價證券代號及名稱']:
            try:
                code, name = item.split('\u3000')
                if len(code) == 4 and code.isdigit():
                    ticker_dict[f"{code}.TW"] = name
            except:
                continue
                
        print(f"✅ 成功獲取上市股票共 {len(ticker_dict)} 檔！")
        return ticker_dict
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 擷取證交所清單失敗: {e}")
        return {"2330.TW": "台積電", "2317.TW": "鴻海"}

def scan_engine(stock_code, name):
    """核心濾網邏輯：均線糾結 + 爆量突破"""
    try:
        stock = yf.Ticker(stock_code)
        df = stock.history(period="35d", progress=False)
        
        if len(df) < 20:
            return False
            
        df = df.reset_index()
        df.columns = df.columns.str.lower()
        
        df['ma5'] = df['close'].rolling(5).mean()
        df['ma10'] = df['close'].rolling(10).mean()
        df['ma20'] = df['close'].rolling(20).mean()
        df['vol_ma20'] = df['volume'].rolling(20).mean()
        
        today = df.iloc[-1]
        today_vol_sheets = today['volume'] / 1000
        avg_vol_20d_sheets = today['vol_ma20'] / 1000
        
        ma_list = [today['ma5'], today['ma10'], today['ma20']]
        dispersion = (max(ma_list) - min(ma_list)) / today['close'] * 100
        
        is_糾結 = dispersion <= 2.5
        is_站上均線 = today['close'] > max(ma_list)
        is_爆量 = today['volume'] > (today['vol_ma20'] * 1.8) and today_vol_sheets > 1000
        is_紅K = today['close'] > today['open'] * 1.025
        
        if is_糾結 and is_站上均線 and is_爆量 and is_紅K:
            msg = (
                f"```ini\n"
                f"🌟【全台股掃描：黑馬突破股現形】🌟\n"
                f"📌 股票：{stock_code.split('.')[0]} {name}\n"
                f"📈 收盤價：{today['close']:.2f} 元\n"
                f"📐 均線密集度：{dispersion:.2f}% (籌碼高度集中)\n"
                f"📊 今日成交量：{today_vol_sheets:.0f} 張 (達20日均量 {today_vol_sheets/max(1, avg_vol_20d_sheets):.1f} 倍)\n"
                f"📋 實戰備忘：此檔橫盤整理平台遭帶量長紅突破，請列入明日自選焦點！\n"
                f"```"
            )
            send_discord(msg)
            print(f"🎯 發現標的：{stock_code} {name}")
            return True
    except:
        pass
    return False

if __name__ == "__main__":
    start_time = datetime.now()
    send_discord(f"🚀 全台股雷達開工！開始全面清洗 1000 多檔標的...")
    
    watch_list = get_all_tw_tickers()
    match_count = 0
    
    for i, (code, name) in enumerate(watch_list.items()):
        if i % 50 == 0 and i > 0:
            time.sleep(0.5)
            print(f"已掃描 {i} 檔股票...")
            
        if scan_engine(code, name):
            match_count += 1
            
    end_time = datetime.now()
    duration = (end_time - start_time).seconds
    
    report = f"🏁 全台股地毯式掃描完畢！\n⏱️ 總耗時：{duration // 60} 分 {duration % 60} 秒\n🎯 今日符合【糾結爆量突破】共：{match_count} 檔。"
    print(report)
    send_discord(f"```\n{report}\n```")

Keep one self-updating Discord message per wishlist item

Integrates the VPS-only rework of wishlist.router.ts, merged with the
status workflow.

- items store `discord_message_id`: the message is created once with
  ?wait=true, then edited in place on every change and deleted with the
  item, instead of posting a new message each time
- the embed always describes the item's current state — status label and
  colour, assignee, tags, image — so a status change is reflected in the
  card rather than announced in a new post
- POST / DELETE / PATCH run in a transaction, with promise-wrapped queries
- images come from a correlated subquery instead of JOIN + GROUP BY,
  avoiding ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY and returning NULL rather than [null]
- express.urlencoded added alongside express.json
- an admin may edit any item; the creator keeps editing their own
- the assign target is validated against authorized_users

Fixes carried over from the VPS draft:
- `if (user.isAdmin = "1")` was an assignment, not a comparison: it always
  evaluated truthy, so the created_by guard on PATCH /:id was dropped for
  every caller and any authorized user could edit any item
- the hardcoded webhook URL is gone; DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL is now required
  and its absence is logged once at startup

commitMessage:
Real persistent site analytics — backend-stored, no new npm deps

Replaces the Discord webhook version with a proper DB-backed tracker
so visit history is queryable, sortable, chartable.

Why this won't break Railway's build this time: no new npm deps. The
previous attempt added geoip-lite + ua-parser-js which forced an
'npm ci' lockfile mismatch. This version uses only built-in Node
crypto (for IP hashing) and inline regex (for UA family parsing).
Geo is fetched client-side from ipapi.co (the same approach the
Discord version already used) and forwarded in the request body.

Backend:
- PageView prisma model with indexes on createdAt/sessionId/country/path
- POST /api/analytics/pageview — public, anyone can record a view.
  Body includes geo (browser-fetched) and ua (browser-parsed) so the
  server doesn't need any IP-to-geo library.
- POST /api/analytics/heartbeat — updates durationMs; pinged every
  30s by the client and on pagehide/visibilitychange via sendBeacon.
- GET /api/analytics/summary — admin-only (gated by ADMIN_EMAILS env
  var, defaulting to nasrrtm@gmail.com). Returns totals + daily chart
  + top countries/paths/devices/browsers + recent visits.
- app.set('trust proxy', true) so Railway's X-Forwarded-For becomes
  req.ip (used only to hash, never stored raw).
- /api/me returns isAdmin so the FE can render the page or not.

Frontend:
- src/lib/analytics.js: trackPageview() with heartbeat + beacon.
  Honors Do Not Track + localStorage opt-out. Fire-and-forget.
- AppShell already calls trackPageview on route change for both
  logged-in parents and anonymous visitors.
- New /admin/analytics page: KPI strip, 30-day chart, top countries
  (with flag emojis), top pages, devices, browsers, recent visits
  table with parent badge. Auto-refresh every 60s.
- Reachable from both classic AppShell and SpecialShell routes.

Required Railway env vars:
- IP_HASH_SALT (any random string)
- ADMIN_EMAILS (defaults to nasrrtm@gmail.com)
